name: aitp
description: Physics research around a research.md backbone: aitp-memory runs one research cycle; research, verify, writing, learning, brainstorming and distill grow the root, topic and branch notes.

interface.shortDescription: Grow research from a connected research.md backbone across sessions.
interface.longDescription: Begin research work and substantive physics discussions with aitp-memory. Its research cycle recovers the relevant research.md (or the root note when there is no topic), reads what the task needs, states what it should settle, uses the needed skills, checks consequential claims, keeps outcomes in their primary homes and reachable, and closes by saying what is supported, where it was saved and what it warrants next. The root note holds directions, cross-topic connections, seeds of new ideas, the agreed agenda and standing agreements; topic and branch notes hold their arguments, with evidence linked. aitp-research investigates, synthesizes sources, designs and runs calculations, develops and debugs code and keeps benchmark suites; aitp-verify checks claims, numbers, references and other models' reviews; aitp-writing writes notes and requested JHEP PDFs; aitp-human-learning and aitp-human-brainstorming handle study and the researcher's choices; aitp-distill keeps reusable methods. Routine work and organization proceed without repeated permission; new investigations, expensive campaigns, installations, submissions and publication are proposed first unless already covered by the request or an existing agreement. No runtime, ledger or session hook.
defaultPrompt: Use aitp-memory and its research cycle for this research topic or discussion.
Read the whole research note and tell me where this topic stands.
Integrate this result into the topic's argument and close with what it warrants next.
Check this derivation, number or reference with aitp-verify before we rely on it.
Distill this demonstrated method into a focused Skill.
